name: Botslab
description: Smart security brand (the security arm of 360) selling home security cameras and multi-channel dash cams. Its own affiliate page recruits creators, reviewers and publishers and routes applications through Awin, Impact or Shopify Collabs with published commission tiers.

evidence.summary: Botslab's own Affiliate Program page (fetched in full) states: 'Apply through Awin, Impact or Shopify Collabs and earn commissions on qualified sales', with published tiers - Starter: 10% base commission, Growth: 12%, Pro Partner: 15%. The 10% published base tier is recorded as the rate. No earnings-cap statement appears anywhere on the page, so commission_cap is unknown.

Program mechanics from the same page: open to creators, reviewers, bloggers, comparison sites, newsletters and media partners (applications reviewed); creative resources and partner support offered; cookie duration and payout terms are set by the chosen network agreement and are not published on the page. The page publishes a US hotline and service@botslab.com. No creator count is published, so creator_saturation is unknown.

opportunity.title: Botslab affiliate program (Awin / Impact / Shopify Collabs)

reasons.niche_fit: Home security cameras and dash cams are core smart-home/tech review topics with strong demo content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own page explicitly recruits creators, reviewers and publishers and offers campaign codes and samples to qualified partners.
reasons.compensation: Published tier ladder starting at a 10% base and rising to 15%; cap not stated, so no uncapped credit.
reasons.contact_access: Open application routes on three platforms plus a published support email and US hotline on the program page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are open now through Awin, Impact or Shopify Collabs.
reasons.credibility: Established security-hardware brand with regional storefronts and published support channels; smaller Western creator footprint than category leaders.

name: Vivint
description: Provo, Utah smart-home and home-security company selling cameras, doorbell cameras, smart locks, sensors and professionally monitored systems through vivint.com/shop. Its publisher program runs on Awin.

evidence.summary: Vivint's Awin program terms state it pays 'a commission equal to 30% of the pre-tax amounts collected by Vivint from the sale of any Smart Home Products' with a 30-day attribution period. However, multiple directories describe the same program as 'up to 30%' (a rate ceiling) and Lasso lists a separate $200 flat per-sale route, so the rate models conflict and commission_rate is recorded as null. No earnings-cap statement was found, so commission_cap is unknown.

Lasso's Vivint listing quotes $200 per sale with a 45-day cookie and a $50 payout threshold - a flat-bounty model that conflicts with the Awin percentage terms, reinforcing the null rate. No creator count is published by any fetched source, so creator_saturation is unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Smart security systems, doorbell cameras and smart locks are staple home-tech content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: An open publisher program on Awin with internal affiliate managers and custom creative assets on request.
reasons.compensation: Headline terms look strong (30% of pre-tax shop sales in Awin terms; $200 flat quoted elsewhere) but the models conflict, so the rate is unpublished for our purposes and scored mid-range.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through Awin; no public program email was published in the fetched sources.
reasons.opportunity_availability: The Awin program is live and accepting publishers for vivint.com/shop sales.
reasons.credibility: One of the largest US smart-home security brands, publicly traded history and nationwide installation network.
